prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Russian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on gold chain (a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold small flared temple bell, a silver miniature anvil, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold bracelet. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Emirati man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth warm golden-tan skin, a playful half-grin, vivid copper-orange hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a copper ship's anchor, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a lead cube-shaped block, a tin miniature anvil, a tin hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver hair ornaments. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
